label: TMP117 Server Room Cooling Demo
info: An Inject node fires every 5 seconds, triggering the periph-tmp117 node to read the temperature and its alert flags, which a Function node formats into a log line. The node is configured in Therm mode with THIGH at 30 °C — a server-room "too hot" threshold — and TLOW at 27 °C. When the room heats past THIGH the node emits a separate {source: "high"} message and the Function node switches the cooling fan on through the second output. In Therm mode the HIGH_Alert flag latches until the room cools below TLOW, so the periodic reading's high_alert field keeps the fan running and switches it off again automatically once the room is back below 27 °C. Replace the "Cooling fan" Debug node with a GPIO or relay node to drive a real fan. To try it without a server room, set THIGH just above room temperature and warm the sensor with a fingertip.

name: format reading / drive fan
